author: Adelaar, K. Alexander
title: The classification of the Tamanic languages
notes: Consulted directly on 25 November 2026 (PDF in Downloads; Table 1 read from the page image). Argues that Tamanic (Embaloh, Kalis, Taman; upper Kapuas, West Kalimantan) subgroups with the South Sulawesi languages, not with Malayic: phonology (§3, Table 1: PMP > Proto-Malayic, Tamanic, PSS), lexicon (§4), pronouns (§5), morphology (§6), a critique of Blust (1981) and Nothofer (1988) (§7). Of three possibilities (Figures 1-3, pp. 33-34) Adelaar is 'inclined' to put Tamanic 'in a direct sub-group with Buginese' (p. 35). Most data are Embaloh, from the author's field work (January 1989); Kalis and Taman from 450-item lists (p. 1). Volume details as commonly cited; the PDF carries only the chapter.
